hypothesis: The exact v51 SP500/SPCX live-v3 route may retain an attributable after-cost edge only when source-native observer decisions reach the backend without internal coverage gaps and complete lifecycles occur on both configured sides.

evidence.role: corrected current-run backend-observer parity with joint-gap accounting
current-run SPCX completed-15m condition anatomy through 39 observed decisions

data_quality.interpretation: Present completed decisions are byte-attributable and field-identical, but the internal two-hour shared coverage gap prevents an end-to-end parity claim.

findings.interpretation: No current-run SPCX entry was dropped among the 78 present cross-symbol decisions, but entries could not be evaluated during the missing boundaries. Condition proximity alone is not a fill or profit sample.

decision: Keep the exact v51 index entry and exit parameters unchanged. Treat end-to-end backend-observer parity as unresolved, preserve the recovered observers, and require uninterrupted prospective boundary coverage through the first attributable SPCX long lifecycle before any profitability or tuning claim.

recommendation.Recommendation: Continue the frozen v51 index route while auditing every future completed boundary and collecting the first resolved source-native SPCX long lifecycle.
recommendation.Why now: The route has exact equality on all present decisions, but a two-hour observer outage created 18 missing symbol-boundaries and could have suppressed opportunities.
recommendation.Evidence reviewed: Corrected 96-boundary parity report, 491 fail-closed stale-status evaluations, current observer process/status evidence, 39-decision SPCX condition diagnostic, and the two resolved SPCX shorts.
recommendation.Observed problem or opportunity: Transport equality is strong when data arrives; continuity and side-complete economics remain unproven.
recommendation.Applicable market regime: Source-native completed-15m index breakout-pressure onsets with EMA21/55 alignment and causal pre-close depth-10 pressure no older than 15 seconds.
recommendation.Alternatives considered: Ignore the shared gap, call 78 present decisions full parity, loosen pressure or breakout thresholds, remove SPCX after two shorts, or continue the frozen prospective trial with explicit gap accounting.
recommendation.Expected upside: Preserves unbiased entry/exit evidence and exposes whether sparse signals are genuine market scarcity rather than missing observer coverage.
recommendation.Main risks and failure modes: Another observer outage can suppress entries; the route can remain sparse or loss-making; both processes may share upstream defects; and one eventual long cannot establish expectancy.
recommendation.Validation completed: Exact profile/run/provider binding, immutable source-prefix hashing, corrected joint-gap detection, 78 present decision comparisons with zero field mismatches, fail-closed stale-status classification, and current SPCX condition anatomy.
recommendation.Validation still required: Continuous future boundary coverage, one fully resolved attributable long lifecycle, additional independent shorts, exact costs and exit attribution, largest-winner sensitivity, and archive/live source-parity resolution.
recommendation.Success metrics: Zero unexplained missing completed boundaries; zero observer/backend field mismatches; complete action or explicit non-action attribution for every eligible decision; protected and reconciled lifecycles; and positive side-separated after-cost economics robust to largest-winner removal when sample size permits.
recommendation.Failure / rollback triggers: Escalate on any new internal boundary gap, eligible observer signal without backend action or exact non-action, unprotected position, mismatched source identity, or a predeclared side-complete sample with persistently adverse after-cost expectancy.
recommendation.Confidence level: High confidence in the recovered technical-gap diagnosis and present-row equality; low confidence in route profitability and long-side behavior.

single_highest_value_next_investigation: Maintain and audit uninterrupted source-native SP500/SPCX boundary capture until the first eligible SPCX long is fully resolved; this simultaneously tests continuity, long-side routing, execution costs, and exit behavior without retuning the route.
limitations: The 17:00-19:00Z gap contains no observer decisions, so whether a qualifying setup occurred inside it is unknown.
The backend and independent observer can still share upstream public-data defects.
SPCX compatible live economics remain two shorts, one win and one loss, net negative after costs.
No exact v51 SPCX long lifecycle exists.
Condition proximity is not an executable counterfactual and cannot justify threshold relaxation.
The repaired parity verifier changes report-only research interpretation only; it does not supervise or restart the observer processes.
falsifier: Update this diagnosis if a later audit shows the missing boundaries were actually recorded under a reconciled identity, if future present decisions differ across backend and observer, or if an eligible long is routed and resolved with complete source, fill, cost, protection, and exit evidence. Repeated uninterrupted gaps would elevate the issue from a recovered outage to a deployment-supervision defect requiring a separately approved operational change.
